verdict.rationale: incident.io's first-party API reference says users can "Download the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec", which is exactly the machine-readable spec this story asks for, and the reference covers endpoints, auth, rate limits and errors. The probe found nothing at guessed paths (openapi.json, swagger.json and others), but that only rules out those URLs, not the documented download, so it is not a concrete dispute. Missing for 10: the actual download URL or file is not shown in the evidence, and there is no hands-on or independent confirmation that the spec can be retrieved.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
